reserves.name: Spiko EUTBL tokenized Eurozone Treasury-bill fund shares
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Spiko euTBL fund portfolio of short-duration Eurozone sovereign Treasury bills

reserveReview.rationale: Usual's current contract-deployments page identifies 0x11D75bC93aE69350231D8fF0F5832A697678183E as the EUR0 Collateral Treasury and euTBL as its collateral. At the current Ethereum block, that treasury held 192,323.85243 EUTBL (0xa0769f7a8fc65e47de93797b4e21c073c117fc80) and no other nonzero ERC-20 holding; EUR0 totalSupply was 191,273.3890531757. The published transparency/on-chain holdings therefore support the full dependency relationship to the tracked EUTBL asset.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Usual contract-deployments transparency and current EUTBL balance of the EUR0 collateral treasury
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The deployed token mapping contains one collateral token and the published treasury holds that token; no additional eligible collateral was present.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The deployed collateral mapping and published treasury identify the euTBL dependency, but the reviewed public sources do not establish legal segregation, fund-depositary insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms for the full EUR0 route.
